scope: Repaired the exact-one-minute rich-policy optimiser so that the mutually exclusive fixed-gap and dynamic-giveback trailing branches each receive an explicit, equal development HPO budget. August remains a frozen final evaluation window and is not used to allocate branch trials or select a policy.

causality.development_windows: 2026-05-01 through 2026-07-31; May calibrates the adverse threshold and June-July supply HPO/tournament rows.
causality.frozen_evaluation_window: 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-27; it is replayed only after a development winner is selected.
causality.selection_inputs: Score-routed target-free candidates and subsequently joined complete one-minute paths. No August outcome, exit, or path-validity field enters selection.
